sentences.translation: Sota: BBQ? I want to go, but I have plans for Saturday afternoon.
sota: maybe it'll be over by about three o'clock.
miku: so, isn't it good from the evening?
it's not good at all even if it's late to make charcoal.
you're making a reservation for the BBQ area in the park.
Do you have anyone who wants to make a reservation that they're still free from 17 o'clock on Saturday?
Wouldn't it be nice to buy a drink on the spot?
Then, at 17 o'clock on Saturday, the entrance to North Park will be set!
